correction_reason: The completed six-seed confirmation at p=26 through p=32 establishes fixed-band robustness but does not bracket the cost-optimal depth. Existing broader precursor scans place several method optima outside that band, and the six-seed costs often continue improving at p=32.

scope.objective: 6150 frozen signed continuous six-variable interactions; every interaction is the selected pair from each of three distinct blocks

tuning.role: wide-depth tuning only; confirmation seeds 101 through 106 remain excluded from depth selection
tuning.history_rule: Within each method and configuration, optimize depths in ascending order. One of five starts receives the preceding optimized solution through the existing continuation rule; four starts remain independent.

selection_rule.per_configuration: For each target, minimize the geometric mean of integer RTS99 times terminal resource units over tuning seeds 900 and 901.
selection_rule.learned_projector: Use the minimum-cost depth of lp_selected separately for each target.
selection_rule.native_direct: Use the minimum-cost configuration-depth pair over both ordinary and both separated-angle configurations separately for each target.
selection_rule.same_state_warm: Use the minimum-cost configuration-depth pair over both same-state warm configurations separately for each target.
selection_rule.target_use_boundary: Targets are used only for depth selection on the frozen tuning seeds, never for optimizer stopping, hyperparameter calibration, instance generation, or confirmation-seed selection.

second_seed_pruning.sequence: Complete the entire initial depth grid on seed 900 first. Freeze and save a pruning decision before launching any seed-901 optimization.
second_seed_pruning.obviously_bad_rule: For one configuration, prune a depth from seed 901 only when its seed-900 Target-A cost is at least 5 times that configuration's best seed-900 Target-A cost and its Target-B cost is also at least 5 times that configuration's best seed-900 Target-B cost.
second_seed_pruning.retention_rule: Retain every configuration-depth pair that is not obviously bad. Always retain each target's seed-900 minimum and the nearest tested lower and higher depths, although those points are already protected by the fivefold rule.
second_seed_pruning.interpretation: Pruning is computational triage only. Seed-900 results at pruned depths remain in the published tuning curve and are not discarded.

refinement.local_depth_rule: For every configuration whose target-A or target-B tuning minimum is not already surrounded by tested depths within two layers, add the missing depths at selected_depth minus 2 and selected_depth plus 2 when positive.
refinement.upper_boundary_rule: If a configuration-target minimum is p=96, or the p=96 cost is within 10 percent of its current minimum and the p=84 to p=96 trend is nonincreasing, extend that configuration to p=112 and p=128.
refinement.second_upper_boundary_rule: If the same condition remains true at p=128, extend to p=160 and p=192.
refinement.claim_guardrail: If a cost minimum remains at the final upper boundary after p=192, report the depth optimum as unresolved and do not claim a depth-optimized comparison for that method-target pair.

confirmation_correction.depths: For each method family and target, run the union of the frozen tuning-selected depth and its nearest completed lower and higher tuning depths. A single trial may serve both targets.
confirmation_correction.comparison: Compare each family at its own tuning-selected configuration and depth. Keep the original same-depth p=26 through p=32 analysis as a separate robustness result.

adam_evidence.existing_wide_depth_source: The completed N=30 Adam full grid on the exact same objective already spans depths 1 through 60, ordinary and separated-angle direct block-XY, same-state warm block-XY, and penalty multipliers 1,2,3,4,6,8 on seeds 900 through 902.
adam_evidence.required_report_use: Use that target-blind frozen-grid evidence to select Adam depths before any corrected six-seed Adam comparison; do not imply that the p=26 through p=32 Adam band is depth-optimal.

primary_metric.name: integer RTS99 multiplied by terminal resource units
primary_metric.optimizer_queries: reported separately and never substituted for the primary metric
